card.name: Linking words before cancer-stage terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or partial drug names in oncology dosing text, just before a cancer type or stage such as mCSPC, metastatic or a cycle count. Often follows docetaxel, cisplatin or combination wording.

modes.label: Link word before disease
modes.description: A word like for, of or with that comes right before a metastatic cancer name or a combination partner.
